decisions.decision: Direct-sale Order draft creation is a single backend transaction creating a DRAFT Order and DRAFT Payment Plan. Client sends editable commercial intent; backend owns IDs, sequence number, pricing validation/calculation, snapshots, timestamps and versions. sourceQuoteId is prohibited.

Support Case identity, case number, SLA deadlines/status, lifecycle timestamps, audit activities and resourceVersion are backend-owned. Core create/assign/transition commands are explicit and versioned. Generic aggregate patch remains BLOCKED.
Agent replies and internal notes are separate commands; backend owns comment/activity IDs, actor identity and timestamps.

Task lifecycle is OPEN to COMPLETED or CANCELLED only. Creation, completion, cancellation, assignment, reschedule and archive are explicit backend commands; IDs, actor/time/audit and version are server-owned.
Relationship activity logging is a separate backend transaction. The client sends activity content and references; backend owns identity, actor and occurrence time.

Refund cancellation and retry remain blocked. Current source has RefundIntent lifecycle but no provider-attempt aggregate, cancellation acknowledgement, retry linkage, same-key retention or terminal-effect evidence. No operation or schema is invented.
decisions.currentResolution: P0.8 later closed provider-attempt identity, asynchronous cancellation acknowledgement and retry lineage.
